caption: The drawing depicts a large, round-bodied copper kettle positioned centrally on the page, rendered in shades of brown, reddish-brown, and gray for highlights and shadows, giving it a metallic appearance. The kettle has a prominent, curved handle attached at either side with circular, mechanical-looking joints, a domed lid with a small knob, and a wide spout with a hinged cap. Three additional detailed studies of the kettle's spout and handle components are shown in the upper left and upper right quadrants of the drawing, each colored similarly to the kettle in reddish-brown tones with gray shading. The background is a plain, off-white or cream color, while all the objects are neatly contained within a faint rectangular border. The artist's signature, "KARL JOUBERT," appears in the bottom right corner outside the main drawing area.
title: Tea Kettle
